item.title: How to automate darts board lights with ESP32
item.description:
My dartboard has its own light and a score display, both on Tapo smart plugs. I wanted them to turn on when I start throwing and off when I stop, without touching a switch or a phone. The solution is a vibration sensor on the board, an ESP32 running ESPHome, and two Home Assistant automations.

Full source: github.com/artosalminen/esp32-vibration-sensor

Hardware

  • diymore ESP32-C3 board with a 0.42" OLED. Native USB-C and a built-in 72x40 SSD1306 display.
  • SW-420 vibration sensor module. A spring vibration switch with an LM393 comparator, a sensitivity potentiometer and a digital DO output.
  • Three Dupont jumper wires.
  • Smart plugs already in Home Assistant for the light and display (I use a Tapo P300 power strip).
